CPI syscall translation, account update, and execution logic for C and Rust ABIs.

# Purpose
This file implements the common control flow for CPI `sol_invoke_signed` syscalls for both the C ABI and the Rust ABI. It uses macros and templated function names to share one implementation across both layouts, while keeping the ABI-specific data access separate. The code translates CPI instruction data and account metadata into the Firedancer runtime instruction format, checks account pointers and argument limits, derives PDA signer keys, and prepares the instruction for execution.

The file also manages account state before and after the inner instruction runs. It updates the callee view with caller-side changes, executes the instruction in the runtime, and then copies callee-side changes back to the caller accounts and memory regions. The main entry point is `fd_vm_syscall_cpi_{rust/c}`, which follows the same high-level flow as the Solana CPI implementation and returns syscall errors when validation, translation, or account update checks fail.
